'''Imperial Edict 1968Z''' was a law created by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the edict was issued by the [[Ministry of Logistics]] following a [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] outbreak on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It authorized all Imperial personnel to terminate anyone who was infected by the [[rakghoul]]s or were carriers for the disease.
